meta.name: fjord_rivals
meta.prompt: Two rival fishing villages on opposite shores of a narrow fjord, one of stone and one of timber, joined only by a rope ferry.

programs.brief: A heavy wooden ferry raft with overhead guide pulleys, tethered to a thick hawser cable spanning the fjord channel between stone and timber winches on opposite shores.
A weathered wooden A-frame drying rack with hung stockfish fillets, salted barrels, and dry coils of rope.
